contexts.name: a2a-gateway
contexts.description: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol surface that exposes Personas as A2A-compatible agents over HTTP. Defines the on-the-wire request/response shapes for the A2A gateway, enabling other AI systems to call Personas agents via the standard A2A protocol. Currently implements the server (inbound) side; outbound A2A client is planned.

contexts.name: agent-chat-state
contexts.description: Slices for the agent chat feature, covering both the foreground interactive chat session and background autonomous chat polling. The mini-player slice provides floating-window state for agents running while the user navigates away.

contexts.name: agent-execution-state
contexts.description: Slice managing agent execution lifecycle — initiating runs, tracking output lines, handling cancellations, and maintaining a pipeline trace with middleware stages. Keeps a capped snapshot ring of completed executions and integrates with the execution sink for streaming terminal output.

contexts.name: agent-lab-quality-state
contexts.description: Slices supporting the Agent Lab feature for offline experimentation, A/B matrix builds, manual test runs, tool configuration, budget limits, and scheduled health checks. The lab slice fetches historical runs; matrix build slice coordinates multi-model variant generation.

contexts.name: agent-list-hooks
contexts.description: Provides hooks for browsing, selecting, and enriching agent/persona data in the UI. Covers recently-used agents, favorites, hover-prefetch for detail panels, a picklist selector, execution annotations overlaid on agent cards, and a shared persona-name lookup map. These hooks bridge the agent store and the persona list/card surfaces.

contexts.name: agent-memory-repo
contexts.description: Repositories for persona memories — long-term facts and context that agents accumulate across sessions. Includes the main memories store, claim/proposal workflow for reviewing and promoting new memories, and memory recall logic for surfacing relevant memories during execution.

contexts.name: agent-persona-repo
contexts.description: Repository for the core Persona entity — CRUD for AI agent persona definitions, settings, saved views, design conversations, and curation scheduling. Personas are the fundamental unit of the app, representing AI agents with configured tools, connectors, system prompts, and behavioral settings.

contexts.name: agent-persona-state
contexts.description: Zustand slice managing the full lifecycle of persona entities — listing, selecting, creating, updating, duplicating, and deleting personas. Caches sub-resources (tools, triggers, subscriptions) per persona ID and exposes a derived selectedPersona computed from the canonical personas list merged with the detail cache.

contexts.name: agent-settings
contexts.description: Per-persona settings tab housing assertion configuration (what the persona guarantees), a settings status bar showing configuration completeness, and a composite PersonaSettingsTab layout. Assertions define behavioral contracts that are checked during health evaluations.

contexts.name: agent-store-root
contexts.description: Top-level Zustand store that composes all agent-domain slices into a single persisted store. It wires persona selection, chat mode, and active chat session ID into localStorage via a deduped JSON storage adapter. Migration logic handles renamed chatMode values across releases.

contexts.name: agent-use-cases
contexts.description: Use-case management tab for a persona: lists, creates, and details use-cases (discrete tasks a persona handles). Provides layout views, per-use-case detail panel with model/channel/fixture selection, a recipes-prototype tile grid for visual use-case composition, and hooks for toggling capabilities and manually triggering runs.

contexts.name: ai-provider-layer
contexts.description: Abstraction layer for AI model providers consumed by the execution engine. The provider module defines the provider trait; the claude submodule implements the Anthropic Claude API client used for inline (non-CLI) calls such as design feasibility checks and triage evaluations, separate from the primary CLI-based execution path.

contexts.name: build-session-repo
contexts.description: Repository for Design & Build Studio sessions — tracks the multi-step agent persona construction process where users iteratively configure a persona with Athena's guidance. Build sessions record the conversation state, step progress, and construction artifacts for each persona design session.

contexts.name: companion-chat-bubbles
contexts.description: Message rendering components for the Athena chat transcript. Bubble renders individual assistant/user messages with streaming state; ApprovalCard and InlineChatCard surface structured assistant responses; ProactiveCard handles proactive nudges; ConversationSwitcher and BrainViewer provide conversation management and brain knowledge browsing. Drives the chat body layout visible to the user.

contexts.name: companion-chat-panel
contexts.description: Top-level chat panel shell and plugin page for the Athena companion. CompanionPanel is the always-mounted listener host that wires all Tauri backend events (stream, approvals, proactive, recall, job, guide) into the store and coordinates turn lifecycle. CompanionPluginPage renders the tabbed manager surface (Setup/Memory/Voice/Decisions) lazy-loaded by tab.
contexts.api_surface: Tauri events: companion://stream, companion://approvals, companion://proactive, companion://job, companion://guide, companion://recall-preview, companion://turn-summary

contexts.name: companion-composer
contexts.description: Message composition surface for chatting with Athena. Composer handles draft text, send logic, slash-command palette, and refine chips. Supporting hooks manage chat scroll position, conversation roster, prompt seeding from external surfaces, and forwarding messages to Athena from other parts of the app.

contexts.name: companion-core-store
contexts.description: Central Zustand store and routing configuration for the Athena companion plugin. Manages all companion UI state including panel open/close, multi-conversation threads, live turn state (streaming text, phase, beat), connector jobs, recall previews, narration timelines, guidance walkthroughs, and the decision layer. Entry point for all other companion contexts.

contexts.name: companion-decision
contexts.description: Hands-free decision layer that surfaces single numbered-choice prompts above the orb for the user to resolve approvals, human-review items, and incidents without opening the full panel. useDecisionQueue aggregates sources and feeds items one-at-a-time; resolveDecision maps Tauri events to PendingDecision shapes; parseSpokenDecision extracts digit picks from voice input. DecisionsPanel is the manager tab for reviewing design decisions.

contexts.name: companion-fleet-bridge
contexts.description: Integration layer connecting Athena to the Fleet multi-agent orchestration system. useFleetCompanionBridge receives fleet session events and converts them to companion store updates. useCompanionAssignmentBridge and useAthenaAssignmentReconciliation track Athena-dispatched team assignments. CompanionAssignmentCards renders assignment status inline in chat. FleetBoldnessDial and WakeCadence expose fleet-specific controls in the companion.
contexts.api_surface: Tauri events: fleet session, assignment progress

contexts.name: companion-guidance
contexts.description: Athena-driven guided walkthrough system for onboarding users to app features. walkthroughs.ts defines the registry of named step sequences; useGuidanceRunner executes the active walkthrough, advancing steps and writing highlight targets to the store. anchorCatalog maps element test-ids to viewport anchors; appActions lets Athena trigger app navigation as guidance steps; composeAdHoc builds runtime point-at and composed walkthroughs from Athena tool calls.

contexts.name: companion-inbox-adapters
contexts.description: Data-shape adapters that normalize diverse backend event types (approval requests, execution outputs, healing events, messages) into the unified inbox item format. Shared utilities provide tone classification and grapheme counting for item rendering. The adapter index exports the full adapter registry consumed by useUnifiedInbox.

contexts.name: companion-inbox-hooks
contexts.description: React hooks that drive the unified Athena inbox experience. useUnifiedInbox aggregates all adapter-normalized items into a single sorted feed. useCockpitSummary derives a dashboard summary for the cockpit view. useIllustration selects an illustration variant for empty-state and loading states. useInboxActions provides action handlers (approve, dismiss, reply).

contexts.name: companion-mcp
contexts.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool-approval surface inside the companion. mcpRequestStore holds pending MCP tool-use requests that need user approval. McpRequestPanel renders the approval card inline in the chat. useMcpRequestBridge listens for MCP request events from the backend and writes them to the store.

contexts.name: companion-narration-ops
contexts.description: In-chat progress transparency components that show what Athena is doing during and after a turn. NarrationThread renders live PROGRESS beats and the collapsed post-turn trail; OperationalThread shows the TodoWrite task checklist; ActivityTray surfaces background connector jobs; TurnSummaryChip, RecallStrip, BrainLinksStrip, ConnectorCallCard, and TaskTag provide per-bubble metadata strips.

contexts.name: companion-orb
contexts.description: Athena's floating orb overlay — the minimized companion presence that lives above app content. AthenaOrb handles tap/hold/drag gestures for open, voice-capture, and repositioning. AthenaGuideLayer and TrackedGlowRing provide the element-highlight ring during guided walkthroughs. OrbDecisionBubble surfaces the hands-free decision prompt above the orb.

contexts.name: companion-orchestration
contexts.description: Operative-memory bridge that keeps Athena's working context visible in the chat. useOperativeMemoryBridge listens to backend operative-memory events and writes them to operativeMemoryStore. parseDigest transforms the raw digest text into structured operation/session records. LiveOpsStrip renders the collapsible ops strip above the chat transcript so power users can see exactly what Athena holds in context.

contexts.name: companion-setup
contexts.description: Companion configuration and memory management panels accessible from the plugin manager tabs. SetupPanel covers Athena's initial configuration including browser bridge connection (BrowserBridgePanel) and sensory signal settings (SensorySignalsModal). MemoryPanel lets users browse and trigger memory consolidation; ConsolidationReview shows the consolidation result for user approval.
contexts.api_surface: Tauri: companion brain, memory consolidation, browser bridge

contexts.name: companion-stream-processing
contexts.description: Pure parsing and signal-extraction utilities for the Athena CLI stream. Extracts stream phase labels (thinking/tool-use/generating), assistant text deltas, narration timeline entries (PROGRESS beats + tool calls), mid-turn intent signals, TodoWrite operational steps, and brain-links. Also provides audio/chime feedback utilities for turn transitions.

contexts.name: companion-voice-input
contexts.description: Speech-to-text input pipeline for hands-free interaction with Athena. useSpeechInput and useHoldToTalk implement hold-to-talk capture and transcription dispatch. useDictation and useLocalDictation provide continuous dictation variants. SttPanel exposes the STT engine selector (Web Speech API vs local). VoiceControlPopover surfaces the hold-to-talk control from the footer.

contexts.name: companion-voice-output
contexts.description: Text-to-speech output pipeline for Athena's spoken responses. VoicePanel is the settings hub; KokoroVoicePanel and PocketVoicePanel wrap the on-device TTS engines (Kokoro/sherpa-onnx and PocketSphinx). BubbleReadAloud adds per-bubble playback controls. voicePlayback manages audio decoding and blob-URL lifecycle. useTtsSettings and useTtsVoiceSelection manage voice configuration.
contexts.api_surface: Tauri: TTS settings, ElevenLabs API, on-device Kokoro/sherpa-onnx

contexts.name: core-retrieval
contexts.description: Pure, feature-gate-neutral retrieval primitives extracted from the companion brain: hybrid per-kind lane ranking, vector-distance relevance floor filtering, and excerpt-vs-full-body decision logic. No DB pool, disk, or async dependencies — inputs are scored `(id, distance)` tuples. Enables persona-memory injection and companion retrieval to share a single verified implementation without an `ml` feature dependency.

contexts.name: core-validation
contexts.description: Input validation for the Tauri IPC boundary: HTML/XSS stripping via ammonia, persona field constraints (name length, system prompt size, timeout clamping against engine limits), trigger schedule and webhook validation, chat message validation, memory content checks, and build-session contract verification. All validations return `AppError::Validation` so the frontend receives structured error messages.

contexts.name: glyph-card-display
contexts.description: Composite glyph card components that assemble sigil sub-parts into user-facing cards: GlyphCard (full overview card combining sigil + legend + totems + dimension panel + model badge), GlyphGrid (multi-card grid layout), GlyphQuestionPanel (question/adoption prompt panel), DimensionPanel (expandable detail panel for one dimension), ChannelTotem (communication channel visual), ConnectorTotem (data connector visual), and ModelBadge (LLM model chip).

contexts.name: glyph-definitions
contexts.description: Static glyph data definition files, one per feature area, that describe how each feature's capabilities map onto the 8 sigil dimensions. Each file exports a GlyphRow[] or similar structure consumed by GlyphCard and related components to populate the sigil for coaching, feeds, goals, KPIs, rate-limiting, relay, roadmap routes, roadmap waypoints, and scope maps.

contexts.name: glyph-utilities
contexts.description: Pure-function utility modules powering the glyph system's data layer: channels.ts (parseChannels, channelIcon, channelTint — parsing persona channel configuration), cron.ts (humanizeCron — converts cron expressions to readable strings like 'Every day at 9 AM'), and triggers.ts (triggerIcon, prettyTriggerType, triggerDetail — display helpers for trigger types). No React; all imported by glyph UI components.

contexts.name: persona-crud
contexts.description: Core CRUD surface for AI persona records — create, list, archive, restore, update, and bulk-delete personas. Commands enforce auth, lifecycle validation, and blast-radius checks before mutations. The DB repo layer (`personas`) is the primary dependency, with cross-reads into executions and automations for referential integrity.
contexts.api_surface: list_personas, get_persona_detail, create_persona, update_persona, archive_persona, restore_persona, bulk_delete_personas

contexts.name: persona-editor
contexts.description: The main persona editor shell (tabbed surface) that developers and power users use to configure an agent across multiple domains. Hosts lazy-loaded tabs (connectors, design, lab, health, executions, use-cases, deployment, model config, settings) and manages the draft/save lifecycle, keyboard shortcuts, and tab navigation. The PersonaDraft abstraction tracks unsaved changes before committing via IPC.

contexts.name: persona-execution-chat-api
contexts.description: IPC wrappers for running persona executions and managing chat sessions. Executions covers listing runs, retrieving traces, managing chains, dry-run previews, circuit-breaker status, and dream replay sessions; chat covers session creation, message persistence, and session context retrieval. These are the two primary interactive paths for invoking an agent.
contexts.api_surface: Tauri commands: list_executions, execute_persona, get_execution_trace, list_chat_sessions, create_chat_message

contexts.name: persona-genome-models
contexts.description: The canonical data types for AI personas and their genetic optimization layer: `Persona` with full CRUD fields and trust model, `PersonaChangeLog` for audit history, `Genome` and `GenomeBreedingRun` for evolutionary cross-breeding experiments, `AgentIr` as a typed intermediate representation emitted by the build-session LLM, `PlatformDefinition` for supported agent platforms, and `EvolutionCycle` tracking a full breeding run's lifecycle.

contexts.name: persona-glyph-layout
contexts.description: The persona detail page layout system built around the sigil: PersonaLayout (three-mode layout — view/adoption/scratch — with two responsive sidebars and a hero column), PersonaHero (name + sigil hero band), PersonaSigilSummary (compact summary in hero), CapabilityTabBar (dimension switcher), PetalRow and UseCaseRow (dimension/use-case list rows), AddCapabilityRow (CTA for adding capabilities), SigilEditModal and its per-dimension body variants.

contexts.name: persona-governance-repo
contexts.description: Repositories tracking persona governance and change management — audit change logs for persona modifications, exposure controls (what surfaces a persona is visible on), deployment history for pushing personas to external targets, and signing for persona integrity verification.

contexts.name: persona-icons
contexts.description: Handles custom persona icon upload and AI-generated icon creation (via Leonardo/Higgsfield). Includes icon persistence, resolution logic (`resolvePersonaIcon`), and the generative pipeline that produces a stylised avatar from a text description or reference image.

contexts.name: persona-jobs
contexts.description: Background jobs and use-case management tied to a persona — scheduled maintenance tasks, use-case CRUD (the lightweight goal/job list on each persona), and a one-off chat command for direct persona-scoped conversation. These commands bridge the persona's static definition with its runtime workload.

contexts.name: persona-lifecycle-api
contexts.description: Provides Tauri IPC wrappers for core persona CRUD operations — creating, updating, duplicating, deleting, and querying personas along with their use-case capability toggles, recipe parameter bindings, execution annotations, and custom icon upload/generation. It also exposes the archetype catalog (mentality archetypes and memory strategies) used by the Persona Foundry creation flow. All calls route through invokeWithTimeout to the Rust backend.
contexts.api_surface: Tauri commands: create_persona, update_persona, delete_persona, duplicate_persona, list_archetypes, update_persona_parameters, sync_capability_parameters, add_annotation, upload_persona_icon

contexts.name: persona-management
contexts.description: Core CRUD and lifecycle management for AI personas (agents). Handles creation, editing, deletion, duplication, and the grid/list views that surface all personas to the user. Persona records are the central entity — everything else in the app attaches to them.

contexts.name: persona-memory
contexts.description: Manages per-persona episodic and compiled memory — raw memory entries, memory compilation passes that distill conversation history into persistent summaries, and retrieval for context injection. Sits at the intersection of execution output and the AI context window budget.

contexts.name: persona-overview-cards
contexts.description: Card-level rendering for the persona overview table: row cells, column definitions, per-card actions (run, duplicate, delete), batch-action bar, health and status badges. These components compose the visual content of each persona row and the multi-select bulk-operation strip.

contexts.name: persona-overview-director
contexts.description: Director-layer quality widgets on the persona overview: the Director meta-persona panel, a completeness ring showing per-persona setup progress, group drag-and-drop rail, per-card health indicator, and verdict trend cell for showing historical quality trend. Also includes the build-status classifier utility.

contexts.name: persona-overview-page
contexts.description: The top-level All Personas list view where users browse, filter and group their personas. Renders a paginated card/table with a toolbar, column-aware filter header, empty state, and constellation variant toggle. Drives the Zustand persona store and the context-map group drag rail.

contexts.name: persona-portability
contexts.description: Import/export and composition workflows for personas — JSON export/import, data-portability bundles (GDPR-style full dumps), and higher-level composition workflows that assemble a persona from multiple archetypes or templates. Enables sharing and backup of persona configurations.

contexts.name: persona-shared-ui
contexts.description: Cross-cutting persona UI primitives reused throughout the agent feature: chat thread and message rendering, persona avatar, icon picker (popup, modal, selector), persona selector/modal for cross-persona references, column filter, and the inline quick-edit panel. These are not globally shared components but are domain-shared within the agents feature.

contexts.name: persona-tools-automation-api
contexts.description: IPC wrappers for persona tool definitions, MCP tool discovery and invocation, automation integrations (n8n, Zapier, GitHub Actions), and notification channel delivery testing. Tools define what external actions a persona can take; automations bind personas to third-party workflow platforms; channel delivery validates that configured notification channels (Slack, email, Telegram, etc.) are reachable.
contexts.api_surface: Tauri commands: list_tool_definitions, list_mcp_tools, healthcheck_mcp_preview, deploy_automation, test_channel_delivery

contexts.name: prompt-assembly-engine
contexts.description: Assembles the full system prompt injected into every Claude CLI execution, composing persona instructions, connector hints, memory, capabilities, runtime safety rules, and CLI arguments. Submodules handle: templates (base system-prompt sections), variables ({{param.KEY}} substitution), capabilities (tool/connector hints), advisory (policy advisory blocks), cli_args (flag construction), resume_prompt (session continuation context), and runtime_safety (guardrail injections).

contexts.name: quick-answer-panel
contexts.description: A lightweight popover surface that intercepts pending interaction requests from a running persona and lets the user answer clarification questions without opening the full editor. Organises questions into groups, supports a review/stepper card flow, and registers pending interactions via a polling hook.

contexts.name: quick-config-shared
contexts.description: Shared types and hooks used by the quick-configuration surfaces across the agent platform: the QuickConfig type definition and a hook that resolves only healthy (ready) connectors for display in quick-config pickers.

contexts.name: recipes-repo
contexts.description: Repository for persona recipes — reusable prompt templates with parameterized input schemas that can be instantiated into persona configurations. Includes recipe definitions, recipe suggestions generated by the AI, and credential recipe associations that bundle connector requirements.

contexts.name: sigil-core
contexts.description: Core building blocks of the 8-petal sigil visual language: the root public API index, the canonical GlyphDimension/GlyphRow/GlyphPresence type system, CapabilitySigil (single-capability sigil with empty variant), InteractiveSigil (clickable/hoverable canvas wrapper), SigilPetal (individual SVG petal element), SigilLegend (dimension key), SVG pattern definitions for petal fill styles, layout helper math (stackOffset), dimensional metadata (DIM_META, PETAL_ANGLES), and the aura/glow art layer.

contexts.name: skills-hooks-sidecar
contexts.description: Writes per-connector SKILL.md files and hooks_sidecar configs into the execution directory so Claude Code's native skill/hook discovery picks them up lazily, shrinking the system prompt. The skills_sidecar writes per-connector skill files; hooks_sidecar writes per-execution hook configs; skill_scratchpad provides a per-execution scratch space; connector_explorer generates structured connector documentation for design-time exploration.

contexts.name: tools-connectors-repo
contexts.description: Repositories for tool definitions, connector definitions, and connector-readiness resolution. Manages the catalog of available tools and third-party service integrations that personas can use. Includes persona-tool bindings, connector credential associations, and healthcheck configurations.

contexts.name: triggers-automations-repo
contexts.description: Repositories for event triggers, automation rules, and webhook configurations that cause personas to execute. Stores trigger definitions (cron, webhook, event-based), automation pipelines, and cloud webhook watermarks for deduplication during event replay.

contexts.name: workspace-taxonomy-repo
contexts.description: Repositories for workspace and project taxonomy — categorizing personas into workspaces, projects, and hierarchical groups. Also covers dev workspaces for the developer tools feature where Athena tracks known code repositories.
